answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 66834 Country: India Title: Giving shop on security Question: I have 1 shop in Delhi which I want to give on security of 10 lacs to a person who wants to do his business from there without giving rent. When he will vacate my shop I will give back his security amount. I just want to confirm is this right or wrong to give shop or house on security. Please answer me as soon as possible. Answer ID: 66834 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1121/1204/L=11/1437) It is wrong to rent shop with security. You should not take the security money rather take the normal rent. Likewise, it is not lawful for one who took a shop with security to keep it without any amount of rent; it is getting benefit by giving debt which is unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
